style: carry on from the previous verse in one line

candidates.angle: The mind must offer every action to him
candidates.evidence: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य (with the mind, surrender all actions to Me)

candidates.angle: The verse pairs mental surrender with buddhi yoga
candidates.evidence: बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः (taking refuge in the discipline of discernment and with mind fixed on Me)

candidates.angle: The instruction is to be constantly focused on him

en.intro: Krishna now gives the inner method for that surrender, and you will hear the mind itself made into the offering.
en.notice: The verse asks Arjuna to use his mind to place every action into Me, then to take refuge in the discipline of clear understanding, and to keep the mind fixed on Me.
en.next: Centered in me, you will cross all obstacles through my grace. But if you do not listen because of ego, you will fall.
en.meaning: With your mind, surrender all actions to Me. Take refuge in the discipline of clear understanding and remain constantly focused on Me.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अब उस समर्पण का भीतरी तरीका बताते हैं, और आप सुनेंगे कि मन को ही कैसे भेंट बनाया जाए।
hi.meaning: मन से सारे कर्म मुझमें अर्पण करके, मेरे परायण होकर तथा समताका आश्रय लेकर निरन्तर मुझमें चित्तवाला हो जा।
hi.notice: यह श्लोक अर्जुन से कहता है कि वह अपने मन से सारे कर्म मुझमें रख दे, फिर विवेक के अनुशासन में शरण ले और अपना चित्त मुझमें लगाए रखे।
hi.next: मुझमें स्थित होकर तू मेरे प्रसाद से सारे विघ्न पार कर लेगा। परन्तु अहङ्कार के कारण यदि तू नहीं सुनेगा तो तेरा पतन होगा।

en.intro: Krishna now gives the inner method for that surrender, and you will hear the mind itself made into the offering.
en.body: With your mind, surrender all actions to Me. Take refuge in the discipline of clear understanding and remain constantly focused on Me. The verse asks Arjuna to use his mind to place every action into Me, then to take refuge in the discipline of clear understanding, and to keep the mind fixed on Me. Centered in me, you will cross all obstacles through my grace. But if you do not listen because of ego, you will fall.
